content.title: How to Watch WrestleMania 42: Night 1 Tonight (April 18, 2026)
content.text: How to watch WrestleMania 42 tonight: Night 1 starts at 5:00 p.m. CT on ESPN2 (first hour) and the ESPN App (full show). Full streaming guide, times in CT, and details for Night 1 and Night 2 at Allegiant Stadium. WrestleMania 42 is here. The biggest event in professional wrestling takes over Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas for two nights, starting tonight with Night 1. Event Details Night 1: Saturday, April 18, 2026 Night 2: Sunday, April 19, 2026 Start Time (Both Nights): 5:00 p.m. CT (6:00 p.m. ET / 3:00 p.m. PT) Location: Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas How to Watch WrestleMania 42 Streaming: The full event streams live on the ESPN App with an ESPN Unlimited subscription ($29.99/month). TV (First Hour Only): Night 1 (Tonight) — First hour airs on ESPN2 starting at 5:00 p.m. CT. Night 2 (Sunday) — First hour airs on ESPN starting at 5:00 p.m. CT. Bundle Option: The Disney+, Hulu + ESPN Unlimited bundle is available for $35.99/month. Live TV Streaming Services: Fubo, YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, and DIRECTV Stream (all carry ESPN networks). International ViewersWrestleMania 42 streams live on Netflix in most markets outside the U.S. Pro Tip for Cord-Cutters If you only want WrestleMania and don’t have ESPN Unlimited yet, the easiest option is to sign up directly through the ESPN App. Many live TV services also offer a free trial that can cover the weekend. The two-night spectacle features a stacked card with major championship matches, high-profile returns, and the usual WrestleMania spectacle. Both nights kick off at 5:00 p.m. CT.Story continues below. For the latest WrestleMania 42 results, highlights, and full weekend coverage, stay tuned here.
